sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: reggel, délelőtt, délután and este can be placed before the activity.

These time words slot in at the front of the sentence and just sit there — no case ending, no agreement with the verb, nothing to conjugate. Compare that to reggel ("morning") itself, which WILL take endings later (reggelente, "in the mornings"). For now, enjoy the one grammar point in this lesson that truly has no moving parts.
